Responden
 Through: Ms. Priyanka Dalal, App.
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
 Order

Applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No. 120/2025 dated 03.11.2025 under Sections 308/318(4)/319/340/61(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding Sections 383-389/420/416/419/470/471/120B of IPC) at P.S. Special Cell, New Delhi.
Subsequently, the chargesheet was filed under Sections 318(4)/319(2)/61(2) BNS, 2023 (corresponding Sections 420/419/120B of IPC) against the present applicant.

2. During course of the arguments, learned counsel for applicant submitted that applicant himself suffers from a neurological condition and has experienced multiple seizures and, owing to the same,
he was earlier enlarged on interim bail even by the learned Trial Court.

3. He also submits that the son of the applicant is having a hole in his heart and he would file requisite documents in this regard within one week from today with advance copy to respondent as well as to the IO.

4. Let it be done.
5.
In case, any such document is filed, let the same be got verified from the concerned Hospital and a report be also placed on record before the next This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/02/2026 at 20:39:15 date of hearing.
6. In the meanwhile, let Nominal Roll be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Authority.
7. The Jail Doctor is also directed to send the report about the present physical condition of applicant.
